column1: # Context-sensitive F1 in MENU mode (the slash menu).
# F1 from inside the slash menu opens the help page for the deepest
# wired item along the current menu path, falling back to "l123
# Commands" at the empty-path root and walking up the chain when the
# current item itself isn't wired yet.
# `/` opens MENU at the empty path. F1 → "l123 Commands" overview.
# Descend into Worksheet. F1 → "The Worksheet Commands".
# Drill into /Worksheet Global → its own page (regression: previously
# Drill further into /Worksheet Global Format → its own page.
# Walk-up: at /Q (the Quit submenu) the visible items No/Yes have no
# help_page wired, so F1 falls back to /Q's own page.
